versos.hebraico: חַכְמ֣וֹת נָ֭שִׁים בָּנְתָ֣ה בֵיתָ֑הּ וְ֝אִוֶּ֗לֶת בְּיָדֶ֥יהָ תֶהֶרְסֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
controles.kjv: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
controles.livre: Toda mulher sábia edifica sua casa; porém a tola a derruba com suas mãos.

versos.hebraico: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּ֭יָשְׁרוֹ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּנְל֖וֹז דְּרָכָ֣יו בּוֹזֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
controles.kjv: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the Lord: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
controles.livre: Aquele que anda corretamente teme ao SENHOR; mas o que se desvia de seus caminhos o despreza.

versos.hebraico: בְּֽפִי־אֱ֭וִיל חֹ֣טֶר גַּאֲוָ֑ה וְשִׂפְתֵ֥י חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים תִּשְׁמוּרֵֽם׃

controles.web: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
controles.kjv: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
controles.livre: Na boca do tolo está a vara da arrogância, porém os lábios dos sábios os protegem.

versos.hebraico: בְּאֵ֣ין אֲ֭לָפִים אֵב֣וּס בָּ֑ר וְרָב־תְּ֝בוּא֗וֹת בְּכֹ֣חַ שֽׁוֹר׃

controles.web: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
controles.kjv: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
controles.livre: Não havendo bois, o celeiro fica limpo; mas pela força do boi há uma colheita abundante.

versos.hebraico: עֵ֣ד אֱ֭מוּנִים לֹ֣א יְכַזֵּ֑ב וְיָפִ֥יחַ כְּ֝זָבִ֗ים עֵ֣ד שָֽׁקֶר׃

controles.web: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.
controles.kjv: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
controles.livre: A testemunha verdadeira não mentirá, mas a testemunha falsa declara mentiras.

versos.hebraico: בִּקֶּשׁ־לֵ֣ץ חָכְמָ֣ה וָאָ֑יִן וְדַ֖עַת לְנָב֣וֹן נָקָֽל׃

controles.web: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
controles.kjv: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
controles.livre: O zombador busca sabedoria, mas não acha nenhuma; mas o conhecimento é fácil para o prudente.

versos.hebraico: לֵ֣ךְ מִ֭נֶּגֶד לְאִ֣ישׁ כְּסִ֑יל וּבַל־יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ שִׂפְתֵי־דָֽעַת׃

controles.web: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.
controles.kjv: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
controles.livre: Afasta-te do homem tolo, porque nele não encontrarás lábios inteligentes.

versos.hebraico: חָכְמַ֣ת עָ֭רוּם הָבִ֣ין דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְאִוֶּ֖לֶת כְּסִילִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃

controles.web: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
controles.kjv: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
controles.livre: A sabedoria do prudente é entender seu caminho; mas a loucura dos tolos é engano.

versos.hebraico: אֱ֭וִלִים יָלִ֣יץ אָשָׁ֑ם וּבֵ֖ין יְשָׁרִ֣ים רָצֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.
controles.kjv: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
controles.livre: Os tolos zombam da culpa, mas entre os corretos está o favor.

versos.hebraico: לֵ֗ב י֭וֹדֵעַ מָרַּ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּ֝בְשִׂמְחָת֗וֹ לֹא־יִתְעָ֥רַב זָֽר׃

controles.web: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.
controles.kjv: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
controles.livre: O coração conhece sua própria amargura, e o estranho não pode partilhar sua alegria.

versos.hebraico: בֵּ֣ית רְ֭שָׁעִים יִשָּׁמֵ֑ד וְאֹ֖הֶל יְשָׁרִ֣ים יַפְרִֽיחַ׃

controles.web: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
controles.kjv: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
controles.livre: A casa dos perversos será destruída, mas a tenda dos corretos florescerá.

versos.hebraico: יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִפְנֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ דַּרְכֵי־מָֽוֶת׃

controles.web: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
controles.kjv: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
controles.livre: Há um caminho que parece correto para o homem, porém o fim dele são caminhos de morte.

versos.hebraico: גַּם־בִּשְׂח֥וֹק יִכְאַב־לֵ֑ב וְאַחֲרִיתָ֖הּ שִׂמְחָ֣ה תוּגָֽה׃

controles.web: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.
controles.kjv: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
controles.livre: Até no riso o coração terá dor, e o fim da alegria é a tristeza.

versos.hebraico: מִדְּרָכָ֣יו יִ֭שְׂבַּע ס֣וּג לֵ֑ב וּ֝מֵעָלָ֗יו אִ֣ישׁ טֽוֹב׃

controles.web: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
controles.kjv: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
controles.livre: Quem se desvia de coração será cheio de seus próprios caminhos, porém o homem de bem será recompensado pelos seus.

versos.hebraico: פֶּ֭תִי יַאֲמִ֣ין לְכָל־דָּבָ֑ר וְ֝עָר֗וּם יָבִ֥ין לַאֲשֻׁרֽוֹ׃

controles.web: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
controles.kjv: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
controles.livre: O ingênuo crê em toda palavra, mas o prudente pensa cuidadosamente sobre seus passos.

versos.hebraico: חָכָ֣ם יָ֭רֵא וְסָ֣ר מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל מִתְעַבֵּ֥ר וּבוֹטֵֽחַ׃

controles.web: A wise man fears, and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.
controles.kjv: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
controles.livre: O sábio teme, e se afasta do mal; porém o tolo se precipita e se acha seguro.

versos.hebraico: קְֽצַר־אַ֭פַּיִם יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אִוֶּ֑לֶת וְאִ֥ישׁ מְ֝זִמּ֗וֹת יִשָּׂנֵֽא׃

controles.web: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
controles.kjv: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
controles.livre: Quem se ira rapidamente faz loucuras, e o homem de maus pensamentos será odiado.

versos.hebraico: נָחֲל֣וּ פְתָאיִ֣ם אִוֶּ֑לֶת וַֽ֝עֲרוּמִ֗ים יַכְתִּ֥רוּ דָֽעַת׃

controles.web: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
controles.kjv: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
controles.livre: Os ingênuos herdarão a tolice, mas os prudentes serão coroados com o conhecimento.

versos.hebraico: שַׁח֣וּ רָ֭עִים לִפְנֵ֣י טוֹבִ֑ים וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים עַֽל־שַׁעֲרֵ֥י צַדִּֽיק׃

controles.web: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
controles.kjv: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
controles.livre: Os maus se inclinarão perante a face dos bons, e os perversos diante das portas do justo.

versos.hebraico: גַּם־לְ֭רֵעֵהוּ יִשָּׂ֣נֵא רָ֑שׁ וְאֹהֲבֵ֖י עָשִׁ֣יר רַבִּֽים׃

controles.web: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
controles.kjv: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.
controles.livre: O pobre é odiado até pelo seu próximo, porém os amigos dos ricos são muitos.

versos.hebraico: בָּז־לְרֵעֵ֥הוּ חוֹטֵ֑א וּמְחוֹנֵ֖ן עניים אַשְׁרָֽיו׃

controles.web: He who despises his neighbor sins, but blessed is he who has pity on the poor.
controles.kjv: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
controles.livre: Quem despreza a seu próximo, peca; mas aquele que demonstra misericórdia aos humildes é bem-aventurado.

versos.hebraico: הֲֽלוֹא־יִ֭תְעוּ חֹ֣רְשֵׁי רָ֑ע וְחֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת חֹ֣רְשֵׁי טֽוֹב׃

controles.web: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.
controles.kjv: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
controles.livre: Por acaso não andam errados os que tramam o mal? Mas há bondade e fidelidade para os que planejam o bem.

versos.hebraico: בְּכָל־עֶ֭צֶב יִהְיֶ֣ה מוֹתָ֑ר וּדְבַר־שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם אַךְ־לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃

controles.web: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
controles.kjv: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
controles.livre: Em todo trabalho cansativo há proveito, mas o falar dos lábios só leva à pobreza.

versos.hebraico: עֲטֶ֣רֶת חֲכָמִ֣ים עָשְׁרָ֑ם אִוֶּ֖לֶת כְּסִילִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃

controles.web: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.
controles.kjv: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
controles.livre: A coroa dos sábios é a sua riqueza; a loucura dos tolos é loucura.

versos.hebraico: מַצִּ֣יל נְ֭פָשׁוֹת עֵ֣ד אֱמֶ֑ת וְיָפִ֖חַ כְּזָבִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃

controles.web: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.
controles.kjv: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.
controles.livre: A testemunha verdadeira livra almas, mas aquele que declara mentiras é enganador.

versos.hebraico: בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מִבְטַח־עֹ֑ז וּ֝לְבָנָ֗יו יִהְיֶ֥ה מַחְסֶֽה׃

controles.web: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
controles.kjv: In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
controles.livre: No temor ao SENHOR há forte confiança; e será refúgio para seus filhos.

versos.hebraico: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים לָ֝ס֗וּר מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃

controles.web: The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.
controles.kjv: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
controles.livre: O temor ao SENHOR é manancial de vida, para se desviar dos laços da morte.

versos.hebraico: בְּרָב־עָ֥ם הַדְרַת־מֶ֑לֶךְ וּבְאֶ֥פֶס לְ֝אֹ֗ם מְחִתַּ֥ת רָזֽוֹן׃

controles.web: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
controles.kjv: In the multitude of people is the king’s honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
controles.livre: Na multidão do povo está a honra do rei, mas a falta de gente é a ruína do príncipe.

versos.hebraico: אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם רַב־תְּבוּנָ֑ה וּקְצַר־ר֝֗וּחַ מֵרִ֥ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃

controles.web: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
controles.kjv: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
controles.livre: Quem demora para se irar tem muito entendimento, mas aquele de espírito impetuoso exalta a loucura.

versos.hebraico: חַיֵּ֣י בְ֭שָׂרִים לֵ֣ב מַרְפֵּ֑א וּרְקַ֖ב עֲצָמ֣וֹת קִנְאָֽה׃

controles.web: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
controles.kjv: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
controles.livre: O coração em paz é vida para o corpo, mas a inveja é como podridão nos ossos.

versos.hebraico: עֹ֣שֵֽׁק דָּ֭ל חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ וּ֝מְכַבְּד֗וֹ חֹנֵ֥ן אֶבְיֽוֹן׃

controles.web: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
controles.kjv: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
controles.livre: Quem oprime ao pobre insulta ao seu Criador; mas aquele que mostra compaixão ao necessitado o honra.

versos.hebraico: בְּֽ֭רָעָתוֹ יִדָּחֶ֣ה רָשָׁ֑ע וְחֹסֶ֖ה בְמוֹת֣וֹ צַדִּֽיק׃

controles.web: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
controles.kjv: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
controles.livre: Por sua malícia, o perverso é excluído; porém o justo até em sua morte mantém a confiança.

versos.hebraico: בְּלֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן תָּנ֣וּחַ חָכְמָ֑ה וּבְקֶ֥רֶב כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים תִּוָּדֵֽעַ׃

controles.web: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.
controles.kjv: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
controles.livre: No coração do prudente repousa a sabedoria; mas ela será conhecida até entre os tolos.

versos.hebraico: צְדָקָ֥ה תְרֽוֹמֵֽם־גּ֑וֹי וְחֶ֖סֶד לְאֻמִּ֣ים חַטָּֽאת׃

controles.web: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
controles.kjv: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
controles.livre: A justiça exalta a nação, mas o pecado é a desgraça dos povos.

versos.hebraico: רְֽצוֹן־מֶ֭לֶךְ לְעֶ֣בֶד מַשְׂכִּ֑יל וְ֝עֶבְרָת֗וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה מֵבִֽישׁ׃

controles.web: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
controles.kjv: The king’s favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.
controles.livre: O rei se agrada do seu servo prudente; porém ele mostrará seu furor ao causador de vergonha.
